affected_component: Workspace reference candidate runner failure marker + WorkspaceBundleError.diagnostics + candidate-generation result diagnostics
invariant: When a drafted workspace reference raises during candidate generation, the public diagnostics must carry the exception type (first entry, unchanged for existing consumers) plus one bounded location line 'Type: message @ reference_impl.py:line fn; ...' (reference-source frames only, innermost non-reference frame named, private temp root masked), so the self-check's bounded repair argues from where the model's own code failed instead of guessing from a type name.
